view2: แปลนเสา ฐานราก — footings F1/F2/F3 + columns C1/C1'/C2 (footing_plan)
warnings: Every column position is printed as a footing+column pair ('F1,C1', 'F2,C2', 'F3,C2', 'F1,C1'', 'F2,C1''): 34 positions = 18 F1 (rows B and E, grids 3-11) + 8 F2 (grid 2 and 12, rows B-E) + 8 F3 (grid 1 and 13, rows B-E). Footings and columns are recorded as separate point elements with the same grid_refs.
Rows C and D carry columns only on the end-wall grids 1, 2, 12, 13; the classroom bays 3-11 span B-E with no interior column (the beam plan's B9/B11 run B-E unbroken).
Footing sizes / rebar are not printed on this plan (detail sheets S-03 onward, not extracted in this run).
Printed under the plan: 'กรณีที่ใช้ฐานรากแผ่ สภาพชั้นดินต้องรับน้ำหนักได้ไม่น้อยกว่า 8,000 กก./ตรม.'
